integrity: Exact arguments establish all dimensions; rational finite checks and independently triangulated low-dimensional hulls provide corroborating tests, not substitute proofs.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the canonical orthogonal projection of the regular cross-polytope to the zero-sum hyperplane; arbitrary projections, irregular simplex symmetrizations, and other Bier polytopes are not covered. The base volume and polar description were already known. Equivalent prior computations under projection or simplex-symmetrization terminology remain possible; independent validation has not been performed.
title: A parity-reversing isotropic comparison for Van Kampen–Flores polytopes
